items.title: No payment taken online
items.text: This website does not collect payment or card details.

items.title: A quote before commitment
items.text: You review a quotation first. A request does not oblige you to book.

items.title: Bilingual enquiries
items.text: The website and enquiry form are available in English and Arabic.

items.q: Is the quote form a confirmed booking?
items.a: No. The form is a request for a quotation. Your journey is arranged only after you receive a quotation and confirm it.

items.q: Which services can I enquire about?
items.a: Airport transfers, private chauffeur, intercity transfers, hourly chauffeur, corporate transportation and VIP transportation.

items.q: Can I request an airport transfer?
items.a: Yes. Select Airport Transfers and add your airport, destination and flight number. Availability for your airport is confirmed in your quotation.
Yes. Enter your pickup and destination in the form. Availability for the route is confirmed in your quotation.

items.q: How far ahead should I send a request?
items.a: As early as you can. The more notice you give us, the more time there is to plan your journey.

items.q: What about pricing, payment and changes?
items.a: These details are provided in your quotation, so you can review them before you confirm.

items.q: Can I use the website in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. Use the language switch in the header to view the website and quote form in Arabic or English.
